premises.text: City data is trapped in legacy silos, Excel, or paper, so leaders lack usable data and spend heavily on manual aggregation
premises.evidence_span: the data is trapped in silos. Cities have many different legacy systems. Sometimes data is scattered across Excel files or only exists on paper

premises.text: Modular governance platform pulls legacy (and paper-digitized) data via a data bridge and produces reports, forecasts, and actionable insights aligned to city services (starting with childcare)
premises.evidence_span: We take data from any existing legacy system and produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals

premises.text: SaaS sold via regional on-site sales with modular pricing below procurement thresholds, setup fee by integrations plus annual module/city-size license
premises.evidence_span: Our modular pricing helps winning contracts below procurement thresholds

domains.name: City data silos and manual processing

value.text: Data-empowered city decisions that improve citizens' lives through more effective and efficient government
value.evidence_span: all city leaders across Europe make data-empowered decisions, improving the life of millions of their citizens

causal_links.evidence_span: when it comes to decision-making local governments tap in the dark
city leaders can track their performance, optimize their costs, and forecast the demand over the next years
we scale through political networks and social proof

notes: Silo/Excel/paper pain folded as one bundle. Childcare module features, map/forecast demo, and data-bridge/digitize-paper treated as cascade of one platform mechanism. Anti-template justified by separately revisable problem, product, and procurement/pricing modules.
